meta.title: Usage balance card
meta.description: A side balance card with balance, previous/current-turn spend, and the live current-window state and price; peak hours are red, off-peak teal, prices include the token unit, and current-turn spend is right-aligned. The card no longer shows turns, cache, or context; the official composer statistics row stays visible. Usage trajectory has separate workspace and current-window summary cards with pale blue/violet solid backgrounds and scope badges—no gradient or crescent-like left border—and blank new Sessions are excluded from the workspace count. The price table lists official Flash and Pro peak/off-peak prices and version; Chinese users see “每 百万 Token”, and the legend repeats under each price column. The selected model comes from modelSelection, so the Current badge updates immediately when switching models; a local model appears below the legends with its own Current row. Summary cards scroll away while the price table and turn header stay sticky. First enable or re-enable runs a full collection across all Sessions, and every completed turn refreshes the current-window and workspace totals. The plugin reads local Session projections and the account balance only; it makes no model requests, appends no messages, and adds no token charges. Local/non-official providers never use official DeepSeek prices, add no aggregate tokens, cost, average cache hit rate, or wallet spend; their per-turn rows keep the local token counts and are marked Local/free. Third-party paid APIs also count toward workspace/current totals and are listed separately by provider/model; their cost is recorded when available, otherwise the vendor bill is authoritative.
